faq.question: Q1. What is Kokrajhar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Kokrajhar University Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment notification (advertisement number KU/12/Reg./Notice/2026/2262) for temporary teaching posts of Teacher for the Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) in Physics and Botany.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Kokrajhar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 post for Physics and 1 post for Botany.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply by email?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application along with a CV and supporting documents by email is 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Kokrajhar University Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-Graduate degree in Physics or Botany with a minimum of 55% marks, a B.Ed. degree with a minimum of 55% marks, and National Eligibility Test (NET), State Level Eligibility Test (SLET/SET), or Ph.D. in Education or the concerned subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled to be held on 28 October 2026 from 10.00 AM onwards at the Conference Hall, Kokrajhar University, Kokrajhar, Assam.
